bar.name: Heavy Hand
bar.text: Your first skill each battle Slows its target for 1 turn.

bar.name: Second Wind
bar.text: The first time you drop below 30% HP in a battle, heal 10% of your max HP.

bar.name: Crushing Weight
bar.text: Your skills deal +8% damage to Stunned, Slowed or Staggered enemies.

bar.name: Stubborn Heart
bar.text: At the start of your turn below 25% HP, heal 3% of your max HP.

bar.name: Stagger Step
bar.text: Once per battle, when you Stun an enemy, your next turn comes 30% sooner.

0.f1.name: Thick Hide
0.f1.text: While below 50% HP, you take 2% less damage per rank.

0.f2.name: Grit
0.f2.text: While below 25% HP, healing you receive is 5% stronger per rank.

0.f3.name: Shared Scars
0.f3.text: Your Berserker bonus is 2% higher per rank for each ally below 50% HP.

0.n0.name: Iron Retort
0.n0.text: The first enemy to drop you below 50% HP is Stunned for 1 turn.

0.r.name: Hardened
0.r.text: Each time you become Fortified, heal 2% of your max HP per rank.

0.ea.name: Measured Mending
0.ea.text: Healing you receive is 25% stronger below 50% HP, but halved above it.

0.eb.name: Stand Firm
0.eb.text: A single hit that would take 30%+ of your max HP is reduced by 25%.

0.ma.name: Red Line
0.ma.text: Healing that would lift you above 50% HP becomes a shield for 2 turns instead.

0.fa.name: Grave Pact
0.fa.text: While below 25% HP, your skills lifesteal 15%, but above 50% HP they deal 15% less damage.

0.fb.name: Iron Will
0.fb.text: Stun and Slow on you last 1 turn shorter, but healing you receive is 20% lower.

0.mb.name: Not Today
0.mb.text: Once per battle, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP and you become Fortified for 1 turn.

0.v.name: Undying Rage
0.v.text: Berserker evolves: below 25% HP, a non-critical hit cannot take you below 1 HP; each hit saved this way costs 10 Rage.

1.f1.name: Knee Cutter
1.f1.text: Double Strike has a 5% chance per rank to Slow the target for 1 turn.

1.f2.name: Notched Axe
1.f2.text: Double Strike's second hit +4% power per rank.

1.f3.name: Hard Knocks
1.f3.text: Double Strike's second hit +4% critical chance per rank against Slowed targets.

1.n0.name: Gut Strike
1.n0.text: Double Strike's first hit Wounds for 2 turns, so its second hit lands on a Wounded target for +20%.

1.r.name: Bone Saw
1.r.text: Double Strike ignores 4% of Armor per rank on Wounded targets.

1.ea.name: Hamstring
1.ea.text: Double Strike's second hit Slows the target for 1 turn.

1.eb.name: Deep Gash
1.eb.text: Double Strike's Wound lasts 4 turns instead of 2.

1.ma.name: Hobble
1.ma.text: Double Strike on a Slowed target extends the Slow by 1 turn and deals +15% damage.

1.fa.name: Crippling Pair
1.fa.text: Double Strike's Slow lasts 2 turns, but Double Strike deals 15% less damage.

1.fb.name: Third Cut
1.fb.text: Against a Wounded target Double Strike hits a third time, but it can no longer be a critical hit.

1.mb.name: Butcher's Carve
1.mb.text: Each Double Strike hit deals +5% more for every turn of Wound left on the target.

1.v.name: Skull and Knee
1.v.text: Double Strike evolves: the first hit Slows for 1 turn, the second Stuns a Slowed target for 1 turn; it gains a 2-turn cooldown.

2.f2.name: Spin Recovery
2.f2.text: Whirlwind heals you 1% of your max HP per rank for each enemy it hits.

2.f3.name: Hungry Arc
2.f3.text: Whirlwind +3% power per rank while you are below 50% HP.

2.n0.name: Gore Wheel
2.n0.text: Whirlwind Wounds every enemy it hits for 2 turns.

2.r.name: Red Arc
2.r.text: Whirlwind +3% power per rank against Wounded enemies.

2.ea.name: Thirst
2.ea.text: Whirlwind lifesteal from Wounded enemies is doubled.

2.eb.name: Reaping Wind
2.eb.text: Whirlwind gains Rage from every enemy it hits, not only from the best one.

2.ma.name: Blood Glut
2.ma.text: Whirlwind healing beyond your max HP turns into Rage: 1 Rage per 1% of max HP.

2.fa.name: Glass Cyclone
2.fa.text: Whirlwind lifesteal +25%, but you take 15% more damage until your next turn.

2.fb.name: Reaper's Spin
2.fb.text: Whirlwind deals +30% to Wounded enemies, but no damage at all to enemies that are not Wounded.

2.mb.name: Crimson Wheel
2.mb.text: Whirlwind deals +8% damage to all enemies it hits for each Wounded enemy among them.

2.v.name: Exsanguinate
2.v.text: Whirlwind evolves: it tears open the Wound on each enemy hit, ending it for +40% damage and double lifesteal on that hit.

3.f1.name: Rolling Start
3.f1.text: Charge +3% power per rank against a target that has not acted yet this battle.

3.f2.name: Vengeful Run
3.f2.text: Charge +5% power per rank against the enemy that hit you last.

3.f3.name: War Gallop
3.f3.text: Charge grants 2 Rage per rank when it hits.

3.n0.name: Roaring Charge
3.n0.text: Your first Charge each battle raises your Rage to at least 30.

3.r.name: Grim Momentum
3.r.text: Charge grants 1 Rage per rank for each 20% of HP you are missing.

3.ea.name: Grudge Charge
3.ea.text: Charge Stuns the enemy that hit you last for 1 extra turn.

3.eb.name: Blood Up
3.eb.text: If Charge hits a target at full HP, gain 10 Rage.

3.ma.name: Payback
3.ma.text: Charge on the enemy that hit you last deals +40% damage and heals you for half of it.

3.fa.name: Martyr's Rush
3.fa.text: Charge Taunts every enemy for 1 turn, but you take 15% more damage until your next turn.

3.fb.name: Reckless Heat
3.fb.text: Charge grants 20 Rage, but its Stun lasts 1 turn instead of 2.

3.mb.name: Into the Fire
3.mb.text: After Charge, your next Headsman's Blow needs 10 less Rage (30 → 20).

3.v.name: Herald of Ruin
3.v.text: Charge evolves: it gains +1% power per Rage you hold, without spending it, and refunds 10 Rage when its Stun ends.

4.u2.name: Gravedigger
4.u2.text: Below 25% HP, Headsman's Blow lifesteal is doubled.

4.u3.name: Grave Robber
4.u3.text: If Headsman's Blow kills, heal 25% of your max HP and become Fortified for 1 turn.

4.r1.name: Ringing Headsman
4.r1.text: If the target survives Headsman's Blow, it is Stunned for 1 turn.

4.r2.name: Heavy Toll
4.r2.text: If you spend 40+ Rage, the Stun from Headsman's Blow lasts 2 turns.

4.r3.name: Mercy Stroke
4.r3.text: Headsman's Blow on a Stunned target cannot miss and always crits, but ends the Stun.

4.d1.name: Grim Calm
4.d1.text: After Headsman's Blow, you are Fortified until your next turn.

4.d2.name: Clean Slate
4.d2.text: Headsman's Blow removes all debuffs on you.

4.d3.name: Executioner's Calm
4.d3.text: After Headsman's Blow, no debuff can land on you until your next turn.

4.l1.name: Dreadful Swing
4.l1.text: Headsman's Blow Jinxes the target and the enemies beside it.

4.l2.name: Blinding Spray
4.l2.text: Headsman's Blow Blinds the target and the enemies beside it for 2 turns.

4.l3.name: Terror
4.l3.text: If Headsman's Blow kills, every enemy is Jinxed.
